relations.subject: Monika Boehm-Tettelbach
relations.evidence: Monika Boehm-Tettelbach studied ethnology, Indology, Hittite and Avestan at the Free University of Berlin between 1960–66. She received her doctoral degree with a thesis on Sadani

relations.subject: Monika Boehm-Tettelbach

relations.evidence: and then at the Heidelberg University's Indological seminar till 1973.

relations.subject: Monika Boehm-Tettelbach

relations.subject: Monika Boehm-Tettelbach

relations.subject: Monika Boehm-Tettelbach
relations.role: Dean of the Faculty of Language and Literary Studies / head of the Department of Contemporary South Asian Studies
relations.evidence: returning to Heidelberg in 1990, where she became Dean of the Faculty of Language and Literary Studies. She was the head of the Department of Contemporary South Asian Studies at Heidelberg until her retirement in 2006.
